title: Security administration
description: Manage invitations, user access and authentication policies.
accessHelp: Security changes require recent authentication. CRM permissions, teams and record visibility remain in their existing settings.
loadError: Security administration could not be loaded. Try again.
failed: The change could not be completed. Check your permissions and try again.
freshRequired: Verify your identity again in Security settings before making this change.
forbidden: You do not have permission to manage this setting.
invalid: Check the entered values and try again.
name: Name
search: Search users by name or email
revokeHelp: This signs the user out, revokes connected-app grants and disconnects their mailbox. They must sign in and connect integrations again.
suspendHelp: The user will lose access immediately. Sessions and connected-app grants are revoked and mailbox access is disconnected. Existing CRM records are retained.
transferHelp: Reassign this user’s deals, leads, contacts, organizations and activities to an active colleague. Authorship history and private email are retained.
requireMfaAll: Require a passkey or two-factor authentication for everyone
policyHelp: Administrators always need a passkey or two-factor authentication. Changing these limits can require users to sign in again.
mailHelp: Failed messages can be retried. Capture means the message is available only in the local test inbox.
requestsHelp: Approving a recovery case does not reset a security factor. Verify ownership and follow the operator recovery runbook. Account closure retains CRM history.
revocationsHelp: Local access is already blocked. External provider failures are retried automatically.
bulkPartial: Some accounts could not be changed. Last-administrator and self-suspension protections still apply.
bulkHelp: Apply the change to the selected accounts? Each account is checked separately; protected accounts remain unchanged.
notFound: The account or invitation is no longer available. Refresh the list.
emailTaken: This email address is already in use. Open the existing account instead.
selfRecovery: You cannot approve your own factor recovery. Ask another administrator or use the operator recovery procedure.
invitationQueued: Invitation queued. Review delivery and acceptance in Security administration.
lastAdminProtected: Keep at least one active administrator. Appoint another administrator before removing this access.
selfSuspendProtected: You cannot suspend your own account. Ask another administrator.
ownPermissionProtected: You cannot change your own permission set. Ask an administrator.
rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
mfaAdministrators: Administrators must use a passkey or two-factor authentication
mfaEveryone: Everyone must use a passkey or two-factor authentication
inviteDescription: Give a colleague access with a personal, time-limited invitation.
permissionHelp: Control what this colleague can see and change in the CRM.
awaitingOperator: Approved. A host operator must verify ownership and complete recovery using the recovery runbook.
